title: Use Seedance 2.5 to generate up to 30s scenes in a single shot (no clip…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 to generate up to 30s scenes in a single shot (no clip stitching).  
Use Seedance 2.5’s stronger reference control to keep character design consistent across the sequence.  
Use Seedance 2.5 video-to-video to turn existing footage into new shots.  
Prompt for fast camera movement and game-trailer-style action to get more coherent camera, action, and storytelling in Seedance 2.5.
